baseDescription:
enhance_prompt authors a directly runnable image, video, or image-edit prompt in the native
format of one exact active destination model. Use it when the requested text deliverable is
explicitly a prompt for a named media model, including a commercial prompt. The caller must
provide destination_model and target_output; unknown, sunset, and omitted models fail closed.

Do not use enhance_prompt for model-neutral prompts, music composition, lyrics, screenplays,
storyboards, treatments, ad scripts, or multi-step workflow plans. Use compose_script for
creative-writing artifacts, compose_lyrics or compose_instrumental for music, and
compose_workflow or compose_workflow_template for workflows.

enhance_prompt returns prompt text only. The caller is responsible for handing it to the
matching downstream generation tool.

parameterDocs.prompt: The source prompt, rough idea, or prompt revision request to enhance.
parameterDocs.target_output: Required model-specific artifact kind: image_prompt, video_prompt, edit_prompt, or model_prompt. Use model_prompt only when destination_model identifies the modality.
parameterDocs.destination_model: Required exact active model selector. Unknown and sunset models fail closed.
parameterDocs.destination_tool: Optional matching downstream generation tool for the authored prompt.
parameterDocs.prompting_type: Deprecated compatibility metadata. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.
parameterDocs.model_title: Deprecated compatibility label. It never selects or overrides the prompt grammar; destination_model is authoritative.
parameterDocs.style_prompt: Optional current style, brand, or prompt context to complement without repeating.
parameterDocs.prompt_mode: Optional model prompt adaptation mode. One of auto, preserve, expand, compress, validate, or payload.
parameterDocs.duration_seconds: Requested runtime in seconds (1-300) when authoring a video prompt.
parameterDocs.aspect_ratio: Optional target aspect ratio, such as 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, or 21:9.
parameterDocs.assets: Optional available assets (schema max 50) the prompt may reference. The exact destination model applies smaller per-modality and total limits.
parameterDocs.constraints: Optional production, brand, model, or user constraints to preserve.
